description: Source code for the AK8975 magnetometer sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, data fetching, and conversion functions.

methods.name: ak8975_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches magnetometer sample data via I2C and stores it in device data.

methods.name: ak8975_convert
methods.description: Converts raw sample data to sensor_value in microgauss.

methods.name: ak8975_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves specific channel data (X, Y, Z, or all) from device data.

methods.name: ak8975_read_adjustment_data
methods.description: Reads factory calibration adjustment data from the device.

methods.name: ak8975_init
methods.description: Initializes the device, checks chip ID, and reads adjustment data.
